verseText: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment.
meaning: Out of all the commandments in the Bible, there is one that is most important of all: to love God with all that we are and all that we have, more than anything else in the world.

recall.question: Jesus told us to love God with all of our... what?

meaning.question: What does it mean to love God with all your heart, soul, and mind?
choices: Love Him with every part of who you are
Think about Him only at church
Say you love Him without meaning it

application.prompt: Loving God includes what you think about, what you care about, and the choices you make. Think of something you enjoy doing. How could you show your love for God while doing it?
